title: DaVinci Resolve 21
summary: DaVinci Resolve 21 is Blackmagic Design's latest major release of its professional video editing and color grading software, featuring AI-powered tools, enhanced editing workflows, and new generative features for video professionals and content creators.
problem_solved: Provides professional-grade video editing, color correction, and post-production capabilities with AI assistance for faster workflows.
why_valuable: Consolidates professional editing, VFX, color grading, and audio tools in one package with AI features that significantly accelerate traditionally time-consuming tasks.
